What do we mean by “Learning Loss”

 • Pandemic related Learning Loss is the
 decrease in attainment associated
 with pandemic
 • The decrease in attainment (Learning
 Loss) follows a decrease in student
 growth
 • We quantify the learning loss by
 showing the decrease in student
 growth associated with the pandemic.
